label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering or celebration in the great hall, plausibly for my forty years as mayor. Freight is arranging provisions with innkeeper and baker, including sixty-four loaves; builder has donated eight installed lanterns and secretary is coordinating access and records. Neighbour's mill errand may support provisioning, though that connection and the celebration's purpose are not confirmed. I was told about lighting and provisions separately, not the underlying occasion.
